title: Benefit Recovery Fund — Office of New Americans — 707 17th St - Denver County
summary: Provides a statewide wage replacement program for W-2 undocumented workers in Colorado who lost their job through no fault of their own, and who are not eligible to receive other assistance due to their immigration status. Program provides cash payments for eligible individuals to help them pay for things like:    Food  Shelter  Healthcare  Clothing  Other critical needs due to a recent loss of employment

fields.service summary: Provides a statewide wage replacement program for W-2 undocumented workers in Colorado who lost their job through no fault of their own, and who are not eligible to receive other assistance due to their immigration status. Program provides cash payments for eligible individuals to help them pay for things like:    Food  Shelter  Healthcare  Clothing  Other critical needs due to a recent loss of employment
fields.eligibility: Individuals must:   Live in the state of Colorado  Be 16 and older at the time of application  Have separated from employment through no fault of their own and can provide documentation to that effect  Have earned income as a W-2 worker in Colorado during a qualified base period or alternative base period (the last 15-18 months)  Not currently be receiving any state administered wage replacement assistance  Not be eligible for state-administered wage replacement assistance due to immigration status     Area Served: Statewide
fields.access method: Visit website to apply. Call or email for any questions or for support with application.
fields.required documents: Must provide proof of identity and a W-2 and/or a pay stub that show income earned and wages withheld. Employment information can either be in the client's legal name, or in a name that they work under and can provide proof that they work under this other name.
fields.hours of operation: Monday - Friday, 8 a.m. - 5 p.m. (Administrative Hours); 24 hours/7 days a week (Website Hours)

title: Options for Long Term Care — Prowers County Public Health and Environment — 1001 S. Main Street - Prowers County
summary: Home and Community-Based Services are for those individuals who are Elderly, Blind, or Disabled and Medicaid-qualified. This program is alternative care that is provided in the client's home to prevent or postpone nursing home placement. Services that can be provided by HCBS providers are; unskilled personal care, light duty homemaker services, non-medical transportation through PATS bus, respite care, electronic monitoring, and alternative care facilities. As case managers, we assess for functional needs to determine if and what HCBS services are appropriate and cost effective. We continue to monitor the client with a care plan throughout the year and complete a yearly re-assessment.
